payload.title: Read-only public wiki: accepted entities become editor-published pages
payload.description:
Expose the knowledge base as read-only entity (wiki) pages. Principle: an entity page is a published Item of type page in a wiki section. A sync job creates or updates a DRAFT Item for each accepted node; an editor publishes through the normal gate. The projector then provides listings, sitemap, search index, agent-readable twin and llms.txt for free. Counts, series and neighbours come from snapshot JSON (see the snapshot epic), not from the page.

Ties to the wiki lifecycle epic PPY-964472: no auto-written wiki pages without a human gate; stamps distinguish reviewed from draft; a stale page cannot look current. Public editing, history, discussion and contributor counts are out of scope.

Parent initiative: PPY-428252. Pilot: Shipped (ship-b35fa2, design story ship-4a59a1). Later option: a dedicated concept page kind reading a guest-readable published-concept model, only if the Item volume hurts.

Children: draft sync; reviewed-vs-draft stamp; suggest-an-edit; topic and beat pages.
Definition of Done: an accepted entity has a public page after an editor publishes it, with no page created or published without the editor.
